urinary_bladder.name: Urinary Bladder
urinary_bladder.description: Muscular pelvic sac that stores urine received from the ureters before discharge through the urethra.

penis.name: Penis (Erectile Tissue)
penis.description: External male copulatory organ containing erectile vascular tissue (corpora cavernosa) that engorges with blood during erection.

urethra.name: Urethra (Urogenital Canal)
urethra.description: Common duct passing through the prostate and penis that conducts urine from the bladder and semen from the reproductive ducts to the exterior.

testis.name: Testis
testis.description: Primary male reproductive organ producing spermatozoa inside seminiferous tubules and secreting testosterone from interstitial cells.

scrotum.name: Scrotum
scrotum.description: Pouch of skin and smooth muscle outside the abdominal cavity keeping testes at 2-3°C below core temperature for optimal spermatogenesis.

epididymis.name: Epididymis
epididymis.description: Tightly coiled crescent-shaped duct on the posterior border of the testis where immature sperm are stored, mature, and gain motility.

cowpers_gland.name: Cowper's Gland (Bulbourethral Gland)
cowpers_gland.description: Small pea-shaped gland inferior to prostate that secretes alkaline mucus neutralizing residual acidic urine in the urethra before ejaculation.

prostate_gland.name: Prostate Gland
prostate_gland.description: Firm muscular gland encircling the base of the urethra secreting a thin milky alkaline fluid that activates sperm motility and neutralizes vaginal acidity.

vas_deferens.name: Vas Deferens (Sperm Duct)
vas_deferens.description: Muscular tube that loops upward over the urinary bladder to propel mature spermatozoa from the epididymis to the ejaculatory duct via peristalsis.

seminal_vesicle.name: Seminal Vesicle
seminal_vesicle.description: Sac-like gland posterior to bladder producing a thick, fructose-rich alkaline fluid supplying metabolic energy for swimming spermatozoa.
